question: closest river to Uganda
sql:
WITH ug AS (SELECT ST_Centroid(geometry) AS pt FROM countries WHERE name = 'Uganda')
SELECT r.name AS river_name,
       ST_Distance_Sphere(ug.pt, r.geometry) AS distance_m
FROM rivers r, ug
ORDER BY distance_m
LIMIT 1;

question: countries within 500 km of the Nile
sql:
SELECT c.name AS country_name, c.iso_a3
FROM countries c, rivers r
WHERE r.name = 'Nile'
  AND ST_DWithin(c.geometry, r.geometry, 500000, true);

question: nearest river to each African country
sql:
SELECT c.name AS country,
       r.river_name,
       r.distance_m
FROM countries c
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT r.name AS river_name,
         ST_Distance_Sphere(c.geometry, r.geometry) AS distance_m
  FROM rivers r
  ORDER BY distance_m
  LIMIT 1
) r
WHERE c.continent = 'Africa';

question: distance between Nile and Congo in km
nearest country to each river
sql:
SELECT rv.name AS river,
       c.country_name,
       c.income_grp,
       c.distance_m
FROM rivers rv
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT c.name AS country_name,
         c.income_grp,
         ST_Distance_Sphere(rv.geometry, c.geometry) AS distance_m
  FROM countries c
  ORDER BY distance_m
  LIMIT 1
) c;

question: low income countries within 1000 km of the Nile
sql:
SELECT c.name AS country_name, c.iso_a3
FROM countries c, rivers r
WHERE r.name = 'Nile'
  AND c.income_grp = '5. Low income'
  AND ST_DWithin(c.geometry, r.geometry, 1000000, true);
